bug_semantics: CWE-416 use-after-free in CreateSaverWindow (Xext/saver.c): SetupScreen captures pPriv; replacing an existing saver window sets pPriv->hasWindow=FALSE and calls CheckScreenPrivate(), which frees pPriv and NULLs the screen private when attr/events/installedMap are already unused (after UnsetAttributes). The next line still reads pPriv->attr on the freed block, disclosing memory (glibc tcache can make attr look non-NULL).
flaw_origin: First write is 9508a382f8a9 (2003-11-14) 'Initial revision' by Kaleb Keithley, which added Xext/saver.c. CreateSaverWindow already did UninstallSaverColormap; pPriv->hasWindow=FALSE; CheckScreenPrivate(pScreen); then if (!pPriv || !(pAttr = pPriv->attr)). CheckScreenPrivate already xfree'd pPriv when !attr && !events && !hasWindow && installedMap==None. Parent ded6147bfb5d has no Xext/saver.c. Later style/xinerama/resource-free commits (including 842ca3ccef10 for CVE-2022-46343) did not first-write this UAF. The 2026 fix ecc634f1b2f7 only re-fetches pPriv after CheckScreenPrivate; Assisted-by on the fix does not attribute the BIC.
